name: Vytshegdosuchus
sum: Vytshegdosuchus is a paracrocodylomorph archosaur from the latest Olenekian Yarenskian horizon of the Komi Republic, Russia.
wsnote: The sources consulted do not give the body length.
holotype: Catalogue number not given in the sources consulted.
material: One occurrence in the Yarenskian horizon.
biology: The sources consulted give no evidence of diet or habits.
